item.tib: tshe dbang gsang sgrub kyi mngon rtogs ting 'dzin dang bcas pa
item.coloph: ces pa'i tshul 'di ni/ grub chen gong ma 'gro mgon 'a zha blo gros rin po che dang*/ rje btsun sman ri ba'i gsung sgros ci lta ba bzhin tu/ bdag dang bdag 'dra'i blo chung khong dge/ 'dir 'jug 'dod rnams la phan snyams nas/ gnas mchog bon ri'i yang dgon/ bde ldan lha ri'i rtse zhes bya ba na/ dus mtha'i sgrab pa po/ bya btang rin chen blo gros kyis sbyar ba dge'o/ 'gal ba bshags cing bkra shis so/ dge ba sems can don du bsngo//
